Three.js 0.187.0 (r187)
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.187.0.tgz
Release: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/releases/tag/r187
License: MIT; see three.LICENSE.txt.
three.module.js and three.core.js are unchanged from the published package.
three.OrbitControls.js changes its bare three import to ./three.module.js for local module resolution.
No runtime CDN access is required.
